critical_code_review_comments: /api/scan/identify-barcode now correctly avoids fabrication (server.py:345-363); response is deterministic and honest about lookup not being connected.
/api/profit/verdict break-even math (server.py:393-396) uses the correct algebra: fixed/(1-fee_rate); guarded against fee_rate>=1 to avoid div-by-zero.
profit_margin_pct guarded by sell_price>0 check (server.py:397) so buy=0/sell=0 edge case returns 0 cleanly without crash.
ProfitIn defaults (ebay_fee_pct=13.25, shipping_cost=0, tax_cost=0, extra_cost=0) make minimal-payload edge case safe.
Frontend env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL); both tests read from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with EXPO_BACKEND_URL fallback so they keep working under either convention.
